description: This file is a unit test class for the Cryptographer utility in the OrangeHRM project. It tests encryption and decryption methods of the Cryptographer class.

classes.name: CryptographerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Cryptographer utility, testing encryption and decryption functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer instance with a key before each test.

methods.name: testEncrypt
methods.description: Tests the encryption method of the Cryptographer.

methods.name: testDecrypt
methods.description: Tests the decryption method of the Cryptographer.

methods.name: testEncryptDecrypt
methods.description: Verifies that encrypting and then decrypting a value returns the original value.
